progress: Lobby in 2:40, plan and nine orders placed, 8 of 9 parts delivered; the camera was contracted too late, so the launch scrubbed on day 180 with 0 of 2 goals and no way to continue.

findings.title: Procurement could not confirm orders: the quote goes stale every game day, so 'Confirm order' keeps turning into 'Refresh quote'
One contracted part arriving after launch day ended the whole game: the launch fires by itself, scrubs, and nothing can be tried afterwards
Science had nothing to do for the whole mission: no research could matter and none was started
Planner could not find how to move the launch date, although the control exists and would have saved the mission
Procurement was not told which need has to be ordered first; the camera's three-month lead time was found too late
When the standard delivery turned late, Procurement's suggestion jumped to the cheapest and latest supplier and hid the one that could still deliver on time
Planner finished in 45 seconds and then had no decision left until launch
Comms options marked 'affects planner' change nothing the Planner can see or do, so the two stations could not decide them together in time
A scrubbed launch is shown as a launched mission: 'LAUNCHED · T+30 d', 'Mission launched', and flight events that never happened
The message about the late delivery sold an expediting bonus that sped up a different delivery
Joining took 2 min 40 s: one invite and one reply code per player, handed over one after another
Players could not tell that the budget is shared or who had just spent from it
A finished one-off Comms project (Laser link licence) is offered again
Science screen gave no hint which research the mission needs
The result screen did not say what could have been done about the late part, or whether anything can be tried again
Before the Planner ordered, Procurement saw 77 parts and 'No open mission needs' and could not tell whether the game had started or what to buy
Comms waited between messages
Share of the failed order confirmations and missed clicks that comes from agent latency

progress: Lobby in 2:40, plan ordered 39 s after the start, both researches done in March, all 9 parts delivered and the launch flew on day 180; the booster engine failed its reliability roll, 0 of 2 goals with 234 M unspent and no way to continue.
verdicts: R1115m-r01-01 stable order quote: helped. R1115m-r01-04 launch chip and move-launch button: helped (panel found; button had no occasion). R1115m-r01-05 order-by dates and sort: helped. R1115m-r01-09 scrub display: no effect (same fault returned for a launch failure). Rework R1115m-r01-03 Science needed by the weather mission: helped (follow-up: Science is done after two clicks).

findings.title: No station could see into or change the launch odds: 92 % / 86 % was fixed by the first nine orders, and 234 M and the last 100 game days could not be turned into safety
A failed launch ended the game for all four at minute 17 of 30: nothing can be retried, rebuilt or learned afterwards
The result narrates a successful flight after the booster failed on the pad: operations contract, first image downlink, orbit raise on schedule, arrival in the slot
Planner was finished 39 seconds after the start and had no decision left until launch
Joining took 2 min 40 s again: one invite and one reply code per player, handed over one after another
Players could not tell that the budget is shared, who had just spent from it, or how much of it was theirs to use
Comms passed a partner's part to Procurement blind: the message shows no price, performance, reliability or delivery, and the result reads as 'accepted'
Procurement saw a 77-part catalogue and an empty needs list until the Planner pressed 'Order 9 parts'; neither side was told that this button is the hand-over
Science's whole mission was two clicks in the first 26 seconds; after that 'The mission needs: Nothing' and no research that could help
No screen names the part that drags the success chance down: the Planner sees two totals, Procurement finds reliability only by clicking a contract row
Calls for Offers went unused for the second round and misled three players into planning around a Call that was never needed
Controls nobody touched in two rounds: delivery options, contract changes, Compare, Department supply; Planner 'Launch now', saved versions, Advanced, Solar system view; Comms licences
The start of the Comms news line is hidden behind the station badge at the bottom left
Produced by the 0.5x calendar: briefing says '1 real minute = 1 month' while the header says '1 min = 0.5 months'; doubled waits for research and between Comms messages
Agent handling: three misclicks from fixed coordinates, and three of four players named themselves 'Sam'
